name: Become Invisible For Brainrots
desc:
Welcome to BECOME INVISIBLE FOR BRAINROTS 🫥🧠

1. Turn invisible and sneak into guarded bases undetected 🤫
2. Find a Brainrot and grab it before your invisibility runs out ⏳
3. Avoid the guards or they will catch you instantly 🚨
4. Bring the Brainrot back to your base to earn cash 💵

Stack more Brainrots to increase your income 📈
Your Brainrots keep earning even when you are offline 💤

Having fun? 👍 Like the game and invite your friends 😄
